name: Nakai
tagline: Shinjuku in 10 minutes and Shibuya in 20 minutes. Served by 2 lines.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, served by Seibu Shinjuku Line and Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 24 minutes to Otemachi, 10 minutes to Shinjuku, 20 minutes to Shibuya and 41 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 18.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 17.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 18.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 18.7 m to 36 m, a difference of 17.3 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 12 clinics and 10 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 久木田医院, about 809 m away and 聖母会聖母病院, about 935 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Seibu Shinjuku Line and Toei Oedo Line. The lines are split between operators (Seibu runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 57.

neighbours.note: 403 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 5 minutes sooner than Nakai.
